svg.title: Evolution — phases concept S2: where multicell starts, and what might come after
svg.desc: Three options for where the many-celled era begins (in the pond after a big-protist chapter, straight from the dish, or in a third world), and a sketch of an animal era after it. Code-drawn.
svg.text: EVOLUTION
· concept S2 — WHERE MULTICELL STARTS · and a sketch of what comes after
Each row is one game, left to right. The icons are the player; the frames are the worlds.
ticket #782 · epic #761
dark-field language of sheets 01 and 04 · zero raster
A · In the pond, after a big-protist chapter (recommended)

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, Consolas, Menlo, monospace

svg.text: DISH · 0–10 min

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, Consolas, Menlo, monospace

svg.text: POND · 10–17 min

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, Consolas, Menlo, monospace

svg.text: SAME POND · 17–25 min
Forms get played for 7 minutes
the forms were reached at 9:40 and never used; the pond gives
them time, and gives their tier II and III upgrades a home.
Colonies at 0.1–1 mm fit the pond's scale: no new world.
Cost: the pond is built once and used twice.
B · Straight from the dish into colonies

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, Consolas, Menlo, monospace

svg.text: DISH · 0–10 min

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, Consolas, Menlo, monospace

svg.text: POND · colonies · 10–20 min
Shorter game (about 20 min)
the form you took at 9:40 divides at 10:00, so you barely play it;
the paramecium and the stentor have nothing to do.
Fewer new creatures to build.
Cost: about 8 tickets fewer than A.
C · A third world for colonies

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, Consolas, Menlo, monospace

svg.text: DISH · 0–10 min

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, Consolas, Menlo, monospace

svg.text: POND · 10–17 min

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, Consolas, Menlo, monospace

svg.text: LAKE FLOOR · 17–25 min
A second pull-back at 17:00
more spectacle, but a second world and transition to build
for sizes the pond already holds (Volvox ~0.5 mm, a rotifer ~0.3 mm).
Cost: about 6 tickets more than A.
LATER, ONLY A SKETCH · the road to animals starts from a sixth cell, not from our five
collar cell
rosette colony
sponge
Trichoplax: a crawling flat disc
a small animal
Animals come from the collar flagellates (choanoflagellates), a sixth line that is none of our five forms:
some of them make rosette colonies (King et al., Nature 2008). A fourth era would start from a new collar-cell form, with sponges
and Trichoplax, the simplest animal, as steps. Not for now: it needs its own world, its own roads and its own decision.
